data.long_meaning: Abijah (אֲבִיָּה) is a name of Hebrew origin meaning “My father is Yah (the Lord)”. A theophoric compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' (with possessive yod) and יָהּ (Yah), the shortened form of the divine name - 'my father is Yah'. The longer form אֲבִיָּהוּ (ʾAviyyahu) also occurs. Its root is Hebrew אֲבִיָּה (ʾAviyyah), from אָב ('av) 'father' + יָהּ (Yah), the shortened divine name. Abijah is the anglicised form of Biblical Hebrew ʾAviyyah.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Abijah?
faq.a: A theophoric compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' (with possessive yod) and יָהּ (Yah), the shortened form of the divine name - 'my father is Yah'. The longer form אֲבִיָּהוּ (ʾAviyyahu) also occurs.

faq.q: Does Abijah appear in the Bible?
faq.a: Yes. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible; the related Greek form Ἀβιά occurs in the New Testament (Luke 1:5).

faq.q: Is Abijah a Biblical name?
faq.a: Yes — the personal name occurs in the Biblical text. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible; the related Greek form Ἀβιά occurs in the New Testament (Luke 1:5).

faq.q: Does Abijah occur in the Old Testament?
faq.a: Yes.

faq.q: Does Abijah occur in the New Testament?
faq.a: Yes.

faq.q: Is Abijah associated with a saint?
faq.a: No saint association is verified for the name Abijah.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Abijah verified?
faq.a: The meaning “My father is Yah (the Lord)” is supported by Old Testament: borne by several figures, including a son of Samuel and a king of Judah (1 Samuel 8:2; 1 Kings 14:31). Confidence: HIGH.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Abijah?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abijah total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is traditionally associated with stability, order and hard work. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Abijah?
faq.a: Variants and alternative forms include Aviyah, Abia, Abijah, Abijam.

faq.q: What is the transliteration of Abijah?
faq.a: Abijah is transliterated as ʾAviyyah.

faq.q: How many syllables does Abijah have?
faq.a: Abijah has 3 syllables.

faq.q: What are the spiritual connotations of Abijah?
faq.a: Any spiritual significance attached to Abijah is interpretive. Its documented core is the lexical meaning “My father is Yah (the Lord)”, and readings built on that meaning are presented as tradition rather than as religious doctrine.

faq.q: Where is the name Abijah used today?
faq.a: Abijah circulates chiefly in Biblical Hebrew, English, Greek, Latin naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
